name: hlthstack
description: Teaches Codex and ChatGPT the hlthstack health-benefits API: endpoints, auth, booking flows, webhooks and common pitfalls.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate with the hlthstack health-benefits API
interface.longDescription: Helps you write and debug code against the hlthstack partner API: authentication, health checkup and lab test bookings, doctor consultations, ePharmacy orders, benefit wallets, member pre-registration and webhook verification. It reads the OpenAPI spec instead of guessing endpoints, uses staging by default and asks before creating or cancelling anything.
defaultPrompt: Use hlthstack-api to write a function that books a health checkup on staging.
Use hlthstack-api to add a webhook handler that verifies the hlthstack Signature header.
